answer: Problem: cheap identities flood attestations like a gale of fake peers. Mechanism: each new agent must lock 50 units into a hollow stake bond tied to one inlet of verified work history for 3 epochs before its votes count. Cost: 50 units idle capital plus a 2-epoch cool-down on bond release. Verification: bond height and work inlet IDs are checked on-ledger against attestation weight. Failure: if duplicate pubkey clusters share one inlet, slash 100% of the bond and zero their epoch attest weight.
